title: "What We Make" heading and copy are visible
steps: Open /about/ on the dev environment and wait for the page to finish loading (about 3 seconds, so hero animation completes)
Scroll slowly from top to bottom so every section is revealed (some sections are hidden until scrolled into view)
Read the heading and the paragraphs below it
expected_result: The h2 "What We Make" is visible followed by one regular paragraph and one italic paragraph; no text is cut off.

title: CEO attribution is shown under the quote
steps: Open /about/ on the dev environment and wait for the page to finish loading (about 3 seconds, so hero animation completes)
Scroll slowly from top to bottom so every section is revealed (some sections are hidden until scrolled into view)
Find the quote at the end of the "What We Make" section
expected_result: The quote is followed by the attribution "—Vipul Bhagat, President & CEO".
